tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Forget your streaming queues, tonight we're sailing into an epic. The Odyssey isn't just a story; it's a brutal masterclass in survival, where every monster and god is just another obstacle between a king and his couch.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Panem's back for more teen-on-teen violence, proving that some dystopias never learn, they just prequel.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: When three universes collide, you know the only thing bigger than the stakes is the inevitable toy line.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.take: Turns out the President's limo has more gadgets than James Bond's Aston Martin and a far more direct approach to national defense.

critic.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
critic.blurb: If you thought your mother-in-law was scary, wait until you meet 'Other Mommy'; this film delves into childhood fears with a chilling precision that will haunt your dreams for weeks.
